#
# Two tokens, ids 19923 and 1031.
#
# WHY TWO TOKENS REACHES FURTHER THAN FIVE
#
# The compressed attention builders are guarded on their compressed caches
# being populated (deepseek4.cpp:1049-1063). At two tokens those caches are
# empty, so EVERY layer falls through to build_raw_attention -- the path that
# is already implemented. The compressor projections still run; nothing reads
# them. So this capture exercises all 43 blocks' hyper-connections, Q/KV, RoPE
# (plain on layers 0-1, compressed/YaRN on 2-42), attention, output projection
# and both MoE routing schemes, without any compressed attention existing.
#
# It does NOT exercise: the compressors themselves, the lightning indexer, the
# sliding window (128, never reached), or the SwiGLU clamp bounds (never hit).
#
# Layer 42 has no next_norm: the final norm is output_norm, outside the block.
# Labels are layer-agnostic; see LayerSums in tests/deepseek4_forward.rs.
